uncoveredTx_note: 15,000 FLAPJAX, block 134590926, 2026-11-19 18:25:44 COT, treasury -> 0xca58696564492ef9c3229c89072365b253bda246. Chosen because the recipient's full chain story is verified end-to-end: first funded with BNB by the treasury itself (0.0005 BNB, 2026-10-27), then paid 15,000 FLAPJAX by the treasury on 2026-11-19.
unexplained: Five recipients (0x56b4..., 0x97cd..., 0xa4c8..., 0xac95..., 0xaf7f...) received FLAPJAX but never received BNB (EOA, nonce 0, balance 0). No on-chain BNB link ties them to the treasury or to any other operator; who operates them cannot be determined from BNB funding. This is a finding, not a data gap: the proof is in the nonce+balance+code checks.

The identity/operator behind funder 0xa5a5491bca93dd4c076e4906e79e7673f4a5a142 (nonce 752675, a very active EOA) is not identified — only that it is distinct from the treasury (its own first funder is 0xf70da97812cb96acdf810712aa562db8dfa3dbef, 3.0 BNB on 2026-08-19).
methodology: Block range by binary search on eth_getBlockByNumber timestamps against public BSC RPCs (bsc-dataseed.binance.org etc.), neighbors verified. Transfers: eth_getLogs over the full 191,923-block range in 2,000-block chunks (96 chunks) on the FLAPJAX contract filtered by Transfer topic with from=treasury; 11 logs found in 3 chunks, 0 in the other 93 — full scan completed with no failed chunks. Amounts are exact integer raw values (18 decimals). First funders: historical eth_getBalance via the Blast public RPC (archive-capable) + binary search for the first nonzero-balance block; funding tx identified from that block's full transaction list; pre-funding spot checks at -1M/-5M/-20M blocks all 0. Never-funded proof: eth_getCode=0x (EOA) + nonce 0 + balance 0 at latest.
limitations: BscScan/Etherscan API keyless access unavailable (Etherscan V2: 'Free API access is not supported for this chain'; api.bscscan.com redirects to API docs; bscscan.com web returns 403). No API key was used or stored.
Subsquid archive GraphQL unreachable from this VM (connection timeout).
Public BSC RPCs heavily rate-limit eth_getLogs (-32005); all chunks eventually succeeded with retries across 14 endpoints — no chunk was skipped.

First-funder search assumes a wallet's BNB balance does not return to exactly 0 and get re-funded before the found block; spot checks at -1M/-5M/-20M blocks and monotonically decreasing balances since funding support the single-funding reading.

Internal-transaction funding was checked for only in the sense that all three funded wallets' first balance increase coincides with a direct value transfer in the same block; a dedicated trace (debug_trace*) was not run because the direct tx fully explains each increase.
